scripts.dev:agent: cd claude-agent && PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 uv run uvicorn src.main:app --reload --port 8100 --host 0.0.0.0 2>&1 | tee dev.log
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.test:backend:all: bash scripts/dev/with-test-emulators.sh 'set -o pipefail; cd backend && ENV=TEST go run gotest.tools/gotestsum@latest -- -count=1 -parallel 5 -p 1 -timeout 90m ./... 2>&1 | awk "{print} /^panic: test timed out after/ {t=1} END {if (t) print \"\n>>> THIS RUN HIT THE -timeout BUDGET (package.json test:backend:all). A TIMEOUT IS NOT AN ASSERTION FAILURE: no test asserted anything false. The panic line above names the test still running when the clock ran out. Do not raise the budget - see docs/testing-tiers.md.\"}"'
scripts.test:agent: cd claude-agent && uv run pytest tests/ -v
scripts.lint:agent: cd claude-agent && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run pyright
scripts.install:all: npm run install:frontend && npm run install:backend && npm run install:agent
